page_note: Page is dominated by an extended physician/sick-man analogy applied to the living soul and the cross of light. The analogy structure (sick person → wise physician who knows the names → declares therapy → contrasted with hostile examiner) is parabolic-hortatory, used to instruct the community how to engage with the suffering Light (cross of light = ⲥⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ ⲙⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ). Teaching purity scores 0.000 — no substrate cosmological vocabulary present. The 'cross of light' phrase is genuinely Manichaean cosmological terminology, but here it is the OBJECT of pastoral exhortation, not part of a systematic correspondential mapping. Editorial fatigue drift toward ecclesial vocabulary in the second half (+3.1) confirms the pastoral character. Heavy damage (65.6%) makes some segments highly fragmentary. Page ends with a citation formula introducing what appears to be Matt 6:21 ('where your treasure is, your heart shall be there') — late editorial citation. No substrate present on this page.
